high_level_description: The image depicts a man swimming in the water, with a luxurious yacht in the background. The man is wearing a black swim cap and goggles on his head, suggesting he might be preparing to swim or has just finished swimming. He is also wearing a large, white wristwatch with a blue strap, which stands out against the darker tones of the water and his skin. The setting appears to be a sunny day at sea, as indicated by the clear sky with some scattered clouds. The yacht in the background is sleek and modern, with a dark hull and a light-colored upper deck.
